gpu_mapping.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition MIG 1g.24gb

metric_definitions.D2: Absolute camera-z residual at bilinear same-body target support for body-warped moving pixels.
metric_definitions.D3: Per-view nearest neighbor in fused other-camera mutually visible same-body point clouds.
metric_definitions.visibility: No measured depth residual or nearest-neighbor distance is used to filter acceptance.

denominator_units.D2: Temporal-pair/source-camera/target-camera comparisons. Source pixels repeat across target views.
denominator_units.D3: Timestep/source-camera sampled points; each point counts once after fusion of other views.
denominator_units.world_body_zero: Valid world-body source pixels tested per supervised temporal pair.

limitations: Occlusion uses finite-resolution point clouds, not ground-truth triangle ray casting.
Surfaces absent from every source view cannot occlude the reconstructed source cloud.
Four-neighbor same-body support excludes boundaries and thin subpixel surfaces.
